items.insight: One command installs the app on macOS and Linux: it finds Python 3.10 or newer or gets a private one, and installs Composer into one folder, ~/.lensmith-composer.

verification.why: Source says it "finds Python 3.10 or newer or gets a private one, installs Composer and its two dependencies into ~/.lensmith-composer" on macOS and Linux.

citations.bears: The changelog describes a single curl-piped install command for macOS and Linux that finds or fetches Python and installs Composer plus dependencies into ~/.lensmith-composer, matching the claim.

span.quote: it finds Python 3.10 or newer or gets a private one, and installs Composer into one folder, ~/.lensmith-composer

items.insight: Every file the installer fetches is checked against a SHA-256 pinned in the script.

verification.why: Source says "every file is checked against a SHA-256 pinned in the script", in a sentence about every file the installer fetches.

citations.bears: The changelog says each file the installer fetches comes from an ordered list of sources and is verified against a SHA-256 pinned in the script, matching the claim.

span.quote: Every file the installer fetches is checked against a SHA-256 pinned in the script.

items.insight: The app runs at http://127.0.0.1:8765/ with a phone-width page, your saved briefs, an optional daily brief and a weekly backup.

verification.why: The source says composer up starts the app at that URL with the phone-width page, saved briefs, an optional daily brief and a weekly backup.

citations.bears: The changelog entry lists the same address and the same four components, with 'if you want one' matching 'optional', so it backs the claim directly.

span.quote: The app runs at http://127.0.0.1:8765/ with a phone-width page, your saved briefs, an optional daily brief and a weekly backup.
